meta.source: Phase 1 visual spec; the DTCG source of truth is built from this in issue #20

tokens.name: apui-surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: input fills on canvas, table headers, code blocks, track of a toggle or progress bar. One tone step below canvas.

tokens.name: apui-surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. AppShell body. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: apui-surface-default
tokens.usage: Card, panel, table, form section: the default container. One tone step above canvas, always paired with --apui-border-muted.

tokens.name: apui-surface-raised
tokens.usage: A container that sits on another container (a card inside a panel, a selected tab, popover trigger). One step above default.

tokens.name: apui-surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog, DropdownMenu, Toast, DatePicker popover, Select listbox. Always with --apui-elevation-overlay.

tokens.name: apui-surface-glass
tokens.usage: Opt-in glass surface for Card, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Toast, Navbar, Alert. Use with backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(var(--glass-saturate)), --apui-surface-glass-border and --apui-elevation-glass. 80% opacity is the floor that keeps text 9:1 and --apui-text-muted-glass 4.5:1 over a pure black, white, red or blue backdrop. Falls back to --apui-surface-raised under prefers-reduced-transparency or without backdrop-filter. Opaque in high-contrast.

tokens.name: apui-surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltip, inverse Toast, a dark band in a light page.

tokens.name: apui-text-default
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface. 12:1 or better in light and dark.

tokens.name: apui-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, labels in tables, placeholder text. 4.5:1 or better on every surface, sunken included.

tokens.name: apui-text-subtle
tokens.usage: Non-text only: decorative icons, chart gridline labels at 3:1, separators drawn as text. Never for information a person needs to read.

tokens.name: apui-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. Exempt from contrast minimums (WCAG 1.4.3), so never the only signal; pair with aria-disabled and cursor.

tokens.name: apui-text-muted-glass
tokens.usage: Secondary text on --apui-surface-glass. One step stronger than --apui-text-muted in light, so it holds 4.5:1 over any backdrop.

tokens.name: apui-border-muted
tokens.usage: The hairline every container carries (Strata + edges): cards, panels, table dividers, menu separators. Decorative; set to transparent for pure tonal layering. Becomes a 3:1+ line in high-contrast.

tokens.name: apui-border-default
tokens.usage: Outline of interactive controls: Input, Select, Textarea, Checkbox, Radio, outline Button. 3:1 or better on every surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: apui-border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover outline on controls, selected row edge, active tab underline.

tokens.name: apui-surface-glass-border
tokens.usage: Edge of a glass surface. A light rim in both themes so the pane reads over busy backdrops.

tokens.name: apui-focus-ring-color
tokens.usage: Focus ring color: 3:1 or better against every surface. Drawn as a 2px ring outside a 2px gap of --apui-focus-ring-offset-color.

tokens.name: apui-focus-ring-offset-color
tokens.usage: The gap between a control and its focus ring. Reassign to the surface a control sits on when it is not --apui-surface-default.

tokens.name: apui-state-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash for ghost buttons, menu items, table rows. Layered over the surface, so it works on any surface or tint.

tokens.name: apui-selected-bg
tokens.usage: Selected table row, selected menu item, current nav item, chosen date.

tokens.name: apui-selected-border
tokens.usage: Edge of a selected item when it needs one (selected card, chosen radio card).

tokens.name: apui-chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (steel). Assign in this fixed order, never cycled; a 7th series folds into Other. Validated for colorblind separation on adjacent pairs (deltaE 28 light, 12 dark). Light slots 2, 4 and 6 sit under 3:1, so charts always ship hover tooltips and a table view.

tokens.name: apui-chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and baselines. Recessive by design.

spacing.note: 4px base. Names are pixel values so they read the same in every stack.

tokens.name: apui-radius-md

tokens.name: apui-radius-lg

tokens.name: apui-radius-full
tokens.usage: Controls: Button, Badge, Tabs (segmented), Toggle, Avatar, filter chips, Pagination items.

tokens.name: apui-radius-control
tokens.usage: Semantic: controls (Button, Badge, segmented Tabs, Toggle, Pagination). = --apui-radius-full.

tokens.name: apui-radius-field
tokens.usage: Semantic: text entry (Input, Select, Textarea, DatePicker field). = --apui-radius-md.

radius.note: Round controls, rectangular containers. Inner radius = outer radius minus padding, floored at --apui-radius-xs.

shadow.note: Strata separates surfaces by tone and edge, not shadow. Shadows mark only things that float above the page.

tokens.name: apui-elevation-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog, DropdownMenu, Toast, popovers. High-contrast relies on edges instead.

tokens.name: apui-elevation-glass
tokens.usage: Glass panes, so they lift off the backdrop they blur.

tokens.name: apui-elevation-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces in Strata use tone, not shadow. The Harbor preset sets this to a soft shadow.

tokens.name: apui-density
tokens.usage: Density multiplier for --apui-gap-* style spacing (#22): 0.8 compact, 1 default, 1.2 comfortable. The five tokens below hold the resolved values per mode.

tokens.name: apui-row-height-comfortable

tokens.name: apui-field-gap-compact
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between form fields, compact.

tokens.name: apui-field-gap
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between form fields, default.

tokens.name: apui-field-gap-comfortable
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between form fields, comfortable.

density.note: Density is an axis separate from theme: [data-density="compact|comfortable"] remaps --apui-panel-padding, --apui-panel-gap, row, --apui-cell-padding-x and --apui-field-gap to their suffixed values. Control sizes do not change with density; pick a smaller size instead.

component.note: Component tier. Each value starts as a semantic token (noted) and can be changed per component without touching others.

font.note: Font stacks as custom properties. Shipped fonts are SIL OFL (Geist, Geist Mono).
